problems.title: Machine-checked security guarantees for deployed cryptographic binaries
problems.beneficiary: Private-sector communications, payments and security software maintainers
problems.outcome: Deliver a reproducible proof connecting agreed security properties to a pinned compiled executable, including precise assumptions and exclusions.
problems.acceptance: Independent proof checker validates the agreed theorem against exact binary, compiler and specification hashes; seeded faulty variants are refused.
problems.blocker: Formal specification and machine-code proof historically require expensive specialist effort and close control of the trusted computing base.

demand.basis: DeepMind's published Signal verification motivates an investigation; no prospective customer, contract, price or independent replication is established.

alternatives.name: Competent specialist
alternatives.route: Specialist formal-methods laboratory develops and checks protocol/code proofs.
alternatives.unknowns: Complete quoted cost, contractual acceptance, delivery time and residual obligations are not measured.

alternatives.name: Human-plus-AI provider
alternatives.route: A security engineering team uses existing provers and frontier models under expert supervision.
alternatives.unknowns: Current frontier-assisted specialist delivery may already satisfy the complete outcome; benchmark on equal terms.

alternatives.name: No purchase
alternatives.route: Buyer continues existing process or defers the project.
alternatives.unknowns: Actual willingness to pay and opportunity cost of inaction are unverified.

problems.next_test: Select an authorized, modest cryptographic library target and freeze the binary, theorem and known-bug mutation test; compare complete specialist delivery.

problems.title: Portable cryptographic receipts for committed-model inference
problems.beneficiary: AI inference providers and private enterprises that purchase high-assurance inference
problems.outcome: Supply independently verifiable receipts binding an inference output to the declared committed model and scoped computation without disclosing model weights.
problems.acceptance: Independent verifier accepts genuine pinned-prototype proof and rejects changed model commitment, token stream and public verification key; calculate complete GPU and integration costs.
problems.blocker: Practical proof cost, quantization scope, model identity attestation and verifier assurance limit economically deployable provable inference.

demand.basis: Anthropic's FlashProve release documents a technical verification need and high proof-generation overhead; customer demand remains unproven.

alternatives.name: Competent specialist
alternatives.route: TEE attestation, recomputation and conventional signed provider logs.
alternatives.unknowns: Complete quoted cost, contractual acceptance, delivery time and residual obligations are not measured.

alternatives.name: Human-plus-AI provider
alternatives.route: Assurance specialist integrates existing zkML or TEE proofs with a customer's auditable pipeline.
alternatives.unknowns: Current frontier-assisted specialist delivery may already satisfy the complete outcome; benchmark on equal terms.

alternatives.name: No purchase
alternatives.route: Buyer continues existing process or defers the project.
alternatives.unknowns: Actual willingness to pay and opportunity cost of inaction are unverified.

problems.next_test: Replay a fixed model and 1,000 prospectively selected challenges using upstream verifier; include adversarial substitution, costs and stronger alternatives.

problems.title: Verifiable long-horizon modernization of complex private-sector software
problems.beneficiary: Companies carrying legacy application, integration and dependency maintenance obligations
problems.outcome: Migrate a scoped, authorized legacy service while preserving its agreed external behavior and producing independently checked deployment and rollback artifacts.
problems.acceptance: Withheld production-like fixtures and contract tests pass across old and migrated systems; security, performance, migration failures, rollout and rollback are independently checked.
problems.blocker: Large migrations require sustained reasoning, complete dependency mapping, reliable integration and recoverable multi-day execution.

demand.basis: Anthropic reports otherwise-infeasible migrations in prerelease work, while industry surveys show widespread build-versus-buy decisions; neither source establishes a particular buyer or a commercially qualified migration.

alternatives.name: Competent specialist
alternatives.route: Experienced modernization consultancy using conventional migration tooling.
alternatives.unknowns: Complete quoted cost, contractual acceptance, delivery time and residual obligations are not measured.

alternatives.name: Human-plus-AI provider
alternatives.route: Internal engineers use frontier coding agents, framework migration tools and automated regression suites.
alternatives.unknowns: Current frontier-assisted specialist delivery may already satisfy the complete outcome; benchmark on equal terms.

alternatives.name: No purchase
alternatives.route: Buyer continues existing process or defers the project.
alternatives.unknowns: Actual willingness to pay and opportunity cost of inaction are unverified.

problems.next_test: Freeze one permissively licensed representative system with an independent compatibility oracle; compare end-to-end restoration, quality and complete costs.

problems.title: Agent-operated procedures with independently checked business outcomes
problems.beneficiary: Private enterprises with recurring multi-step, tool-using standard operating procedures
problems.outcome: Produce and verify a scoped business-process outcome through permitted tools under explicit policy, recovery and refusal requirements.
problems.acceptance: Held-out SOP task suite with realistic tools demonstrates correctness, policy compliance, restart recovery, audit evidence and bounded support obligations.
problems.blocker: Tasks mix ambiguous instructions, tool calls, exceptions and domain-specific criteria; headline model scores do not establish reliable end-to-end service.

demand.basis: Amazon SOP-Bench documents genuine procedure-level reliability gaps, not committed purchase demand for an autonomous provider.

alternatives.name: Competent specialist
alternatives.route: Trained operators perform the existing SOP through established business software.
alternatives.unknowns: Complete quoted cost, contractual acceptance, delivery time and residual obligations are not measured.

alternatives.name: Human-plus-AI provider
alternatives.route: Internal process team deploys conventional automation plus supervised agents and independent checks.
alternatives.unknowns: Current frontier-assisted specialist delivery may already satisfy the complete outcome; benchmark on equal terms.

alternatives.name: No purchase
alternatives.route: Buyer continues existing process or defers the project.
alternatives.unknowns: Actual willingness to pay and opportunity cost of inaction are unverified.

problems.next_test: Pre-register a permitted public SOP benchmark subset and hidden perturbations; compare model/tool configurations and current incumbent costs.

problems.title: Reliable computer-use workcells replacing brittle manual integration
problems.beneficiary: Private-sector software operators with repetitive cross-application reconciliations and reporting
problems.outcome: Deliver a specified cross-application outcome with verified state changes, replay-safe steps and complete recovery receipts rather than unverified clicks.
problems.acceptance: Independent before/after application-state checks, adversarial UI changes, permission checks and repeat-run idempotence demonstrate the agreed result.
problems.blocker: Computer-use reliability, tool friction, recovery and cost can make superficially simple cross-software automations uneconomic.

demand.basis: OpenAI's October 26 release documents expanded computer-use availability; business use and willingness to pay remain unverified.

alternatives.name: Competent specialist
alternatives.route: Enterprise RPA integrator builds explicit API/RPA automation.
alternatives.unknowns: Complete quoted cost, contractual acceptance, delivery time and residual obligations are not measured.

alternatives.name: Human-plus-AI provider
alternatives.route: In-house team uses existing computer-use models and workflow software.
alternatives.unknowns: Current frontier-assisted specialist delivery may already satisfy the complete outcome; benchmark on equal terms.

alternatives.name: No purchase
alternatives.route: Buyer continues existing process or defers the project.
alternatives.unknowns: Actual willingness to pay and opportunity cost of inaction are unverified.

problems.next_test: Freeze a legal/public sandbox workflow with deterministic state checker and independent API-based/RPA competitor; measure full completion cost.

problems.title: Autonomous electronic-device design with independent physical acceptance
problems.beneficiary: Hardware innovators who need design-to-tested-prototype cycles
problems.outcome: Create a bounded electronic subsystem design and manufacturing/test package that achieves independently measured performance and safety limits.
problems.acceptance: Third-party bench measurements on produced boards match prospectively frozen electrical, thermal and fault-handling requirements; test fixture and BOM are included.
problems.blocker: AI can propose device designs, but fabrication, toolchains, physical measurements and iterative corrections remain costly and uncertain.

demand.basis: Anthropic reports working electronic-device designs in prerelease research, but no general reproducibility, independent physical qualification or buyer demand is established here.

alternatives.name: Competent specialist
alternatives.route: Electronics design consultancy with established simulation and prototyping tools.
alternatives.unknowns: Complete quoted cost, contractual acceptance, delivery time and residual obligations are not measured.

alternatives.name: Human-plus-AI provider
alternatives.route: Expert engineer uses model-assisted EDA, conventional design automation and a fabrication laboratory.
alternatives.unknowns: Current frontier-assisted specialist delivery may already satisfy the complete outcome; benchmark on equal terms.

alternatives.name: No purchase
alternatives.route: Buyer continues existing process or defers the project.
alternatives.unknowns: Actual willingness to pay and opportunity cost of inaction are unverified.

problems.next_test: Choose a low-risk lab demonstrator with open BOM and independent test bench; compare physical yields and full human-plus-AI alternative cost.
